The '''Takara Mountains''', known originally by the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as the '''Cetajan Mountains''', were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range on the remote [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Omen]]'', crash-landed in these mountains. The survivors of the crash were stranded on the planet and eventually formed the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. They built a [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]] in the mountains, over and around the crash site of the ''Omen''.

[[Grand Lord]] [[Nida Korsin]] ordered the Sith Tribe to abandon the Temple in the mountains, an order that remained in effect for over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jelph Marrian]] crash-landed in the jungle highlands in the mountains; he lived among the Sith as a poor [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who traded with the Keshiri, although [[Sith Saber]] [[Orielle Kitai]] eventually discovered the truth of his past. The two fell in love and moved to a new home in the jungle after Marrian's farm was [[Night of the Upside-Down Meteor|destroyed]] in battle with the [[Lillia Venn|Grand Lord]]. By [[41 ABY]], the Sith had returned to the Temple and the mountains.

==Description==
{{Quote|That's&mdash;that's a granite peak. It's not volcanic!''"<br />''"It is ''now!|Adari Vaal and [[Izri Dazh]]|<ref name="Skyborn">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Keshtah.jpg|thumb|right|Location of the mountains, as marked on the map of the continent [[Keshtah Minor]]]].
The Takara [[Mountain/Legends|Mountains]] were a range located on the remote<ref name="Skyborn" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Rocky, sharp, and ridged, they bordered one of the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. Located within the mountains was a [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]], built by a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|group of Sith]] that was stranded on the planet in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] after their [[Sith dreadnaught|vessel]], the ''[[Omen]]'', crashed into the mountain range. The mountains were very steep, and the Temple was accessible only by air or by a hazardous climb up the slopes.<ref name="Omen" />

The mountains were tall, rising high into the air; and some of them even accumulated [[Water/Legends|snow]] on their tips. The slopes were covered in loose rock, although there were also clearings of grass in the lower areas of the mountains.<ref name="Precipice" /> At the base of the mountains were grassy foothills, and many of the mountains themselves were covered in a dense jungle&mdash;in which even most of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] did not dare venture. Although the majority of the mountains were not volcanic, by [[3960 BBY]] there were still several active volcanoes among the range. The [[Marisota River]] also ran from the jungle highlands down to the lowlands below.<ref name="Purgatory" />

==History==
{{Quote|No, I've ordered that all Sith remove themselves from this mountain, in honor of Father's passing. While I live, none may return here.|Nida Korsin|<ref name="Savior">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Savior]]''</ref>}}
In 5,000 BBY, during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], a Sith [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the ''Omen'', was attempting to deliver a shipment of [[Lignan crystal]]s to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] when the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|knocked off course]] while executing a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump. After coming out of hyperspace very close to the remote planet Kesh, it was forced to crash-land in the world's Takara Mountain range&mdash;then known as the Cetajan Range.<ref name="Precipice" /> The crash was witnessed by the indigenous [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]], and they believed it to be a volcanic eruption. The Keshiri took the eruption as a sign that their [[Deity/Legends|gods]], the [[Skyborn]], were angry at them because of the heretic teachings of [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] [[Adari Vaal]]. Vaal was forced to escape Tahv on the back of her [[uvak]], [[Nink (uvak)|Nink]], and she took up refuge in the mountains, where she saw the wreckage of the ''Omen''.<ref name="Skyborn" /> Meanwhile, the ''Omen''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Yaru Korsin]], [[Duel near the Omen|dueled]] his brother, [[Devore Korsin]], on the crash-site of the ship, over which of them would lead the Sith survivors. Yaru [[Death/Legends|killed]] Devore by dropping him over the edge of a precipice into the ocean below.<ref name="Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref>

[[File:KeshSithTemple.jpg|thumb|left|175px|The Sith Temple in the Takara Mountains]]
The survivors of the crash, who eventually formed a new Tribe of Sith, soon befriended the planet's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Keshiri, who believed the newcomers to be their gods and pledged themselves to [[Slavery/Legends|service]] to the Sith.<ref name="Skyborn" /> The Sith used the Keshiri to assist them in the construction of a new [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] over and around the ruins of the ''Omen'' in the mountains.<ref name="Omen" /> By [[4985 BBY]], the Cetajan Range had been renamed the Takara Mountains after Yaru Korsin's [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Takara Korsin]].<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref> [[4975 BBY|Ten years]] later, [[Duel near the Kesh Sith Temple|another duel]] took place near the ''Omen''{{'s}} crash site in the Takara Mountains, in which Korsin and his nephew, [[Jariad Korsin]], were killed. Yaru Korsin's daughter, [[Nida Korsin|Nida]], then became the Tribe's [[Grand Lord]].<ref name="Savior" />

In memory of her [[Parent/Legends|father]], Nida Korsin ordered the Sith to abandon the Temple in the mountains, so the Sith moved to Tahv&mdash;and the move remained in effect for generations after Korsin's death.<ref name="Savior" /> As such, when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jelph Marrian]] crashed in the jungle highlands in [[3963 BBY]], his presence was not immediately detected. Marrian began to live on a [[Jelph Marrian's farm|farm]] near the Marisota River, and although he eventually found the Sith, he masqueraded as a slave who [[Merchant/Legends|traded]] with the Keshiri. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], he managed to recover his [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|starfighter]] piece-by-piece from the jungle highlands, bringing it down from the mountains and hiding it near his home. However, in [[3960 BBY]], his past was discovered by the [[Sith Saber]] [[Orielle Kitai]]&mdash;who had recently fallen prey to a [[Assassination attempt in the Korsinata|conspiracy]] that resulted in her being made a slave&mdash;and she quickly moved to reveal this information to the rest of the Sith as a way to ensure her reinstatement in the Tribe.<ref name="Purgatory" /> Marrian intercepted her, however, and the two realized their love for each other. Upon returning to Marrian's farm, they [[Night of the Upside-Down Meteor|battled]] the Grand Lord [[Lillia Venn]] and her Sith allies, killing them, but destroying Marrian's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] in the process. Marrian and Kitai then left behind their old lives and moved to a new home in the Mountains.<ref name="Sentinel">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]''</ref>

Eventually, the Sith returned to the temple in the mountains. The [[Sith Tyro]]s often [[Sith training|trained]] in the shadows of the mountains in the [[Temple courtyard|Sith Temple courtyard]]. In [[41 ABY]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] known as [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] arrived on Kesh to make contact with the Tribe and help train their [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]]. It first spoke through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] with Tyro [[Vestara Khai]] in the Temple courtyard, in the midst of the mountain range.<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Takara Mountains first appeared as an unnamed mountain range in the [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]'', released on [[May 28]], [[2009]]. They were later named in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', author [[Christie Golden]]'s first ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel and the second installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, released on [[June 23]], 2009. The Mountains were then shown to be identified by the Keshiri as the "Cetajan Mountains" in the second [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] eBook, [[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn|''Skyborn'']], and they have subsequently appeared in each of the eBooks in that series to date.
